214Rūpa Gosāñi was delayed in Gauḍa for a year: he divided his wealth and gave it to his relatives for their maintenance.

গৌড়ে যে অর্থ ছিল, তাহা আনাইলা ৷
কুটুম্ব-ব্রাহ্মণ-দেবালয়ে বাঁটি’ দিলা ॥ ২১৫ ॥

gauḍe ye artha chila, tāhā ānāilā
in Gauḍa what wealth there was that he had brought
kuṭumba-brāhmaṇa-devālaye bām̐ṭi’ dilā
to relatives brāhmaṇas temples distributing he gave

215He had the wealth he held in Gauḍa brought to him and distributed it among his relatives, the brāhmaṇas and the temples.

সব মনঃকথা গোসাঞি করি’ নির্ব্বাহণ ৷
নিশ্চিন্ত হঞা শীঘ্র আইলা বৃন্দাবন ॥ ২১৬ ॥

saba manaḥ-kathā gosāñi kari’ nirvāhaṇa
all his heart’s wishes Gosāñi having accomplished
niścinta hañā śīghra āilā vṛndāvana
free from care becoming quickly came to Vṛndāvana

216When he had accomplished all he had in mind, the Gosāñi, free from care, quickly came to Vṛndāvana.

দুইভাই মিলি’ বৃন্দাবনে বাস কৈলা ৷
প্রভুর যে আজ্ঞা, দুঁহে সব নির্ব্বাহিলা ॥ ২১৭ ॥

duibhāi mili’ vṛndāvane vāsa kailā
the two brothers having met in Vṛndāvana residence made
prabhura ye ājñā, dum̐he saba nirvāhilā
of the Lord what orders the two all carried out

217The two brothers met and lived together in Vṛndāvana, and they carried out all the Lord’s orders.

নানাশাস্ত্র আনি’ লুপ্ত-তীর্থ উদ্ধারিলা ৷
বৃন্দাবনে কৃষ্ণসেবা প্রকাশ করিলা ॥ ২১৮ ॥

nānā-śāstra āni’ lupta-tīrtha uddhārilā
many scriptures having gathered the lost holy places they recovered
vṛndāvane kṛṣṇa-sevā prakāśa karilā
in Vṛndāvana the service of Kṛṣṇa manifestation made

218Gathering many scriptures, they recovered the lost holy places and manifested the service of Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana.28

সনাতন গ্রন্থ কৈলা ‘ভাগবতামৃতে’ ৷
ভক্ত-ভক্তি-কৃষ্ণ-তত্ত্ব জানি যাহা হৈতে ॥ ২১৯ ॥

sanātana grantha kailā ‘bhāgavatāmṛte’
Sanātana a book made the Bhāgavatāmṛta
bhakta-bhakti-kṛṣṇa-tattva jāni yāhā haite
devotee devotion Kṛṣṇa the truth we know which from

219Sanātana wrote the Bhāgavatāmṛta, from which we know the truth of the devotee, devotion and Kṛṣṇa.

সিদ্ধান্তসার গ্রন্থ কৈলা ‘দশম-টিপ্পনী’ ৷
কৃষ্ণলীলারস-প্রেম যাহা হৈতে জানি ॥ ২২০ ॥

siddhānta-sāra grantha kailā ‘daśama-ṭippanī’
the essence of conclusions a book he made the Daśama-ṭippanī
kṛṣṇa-līlā-rasa-prema yāhā haite jāni
of Kṛṣṇa’s pastimes rasa love which from we know

220He wrote the Daśama-ṭippanī, the essence of conclusions, from which we know the rasa of Kṛṣṇa’s pastimes and love for Him.29

‘হরিভক্তিবিলাস’-গ্রন্থ কৈলা বৈষ্ণব-আচার ৷
বৈষ্ণবের কর্ত্তব্য যাঁহা পাইয়ে পার ॥ ২২১ ॥

‘hari-bhakti-vilāsa’-grantha kailā vaiṣṇava-ācāra
the Hari-bhakti-vilāsa a book he made of Vaiṣṇava conduct
vaiṣṇavera kartavya yām̐hā pāiye pāra
of a Vaiṣṇava the duties in which we find to the end

221He wrote the Hari-bhakti-vilāsa on Vaiṣṇava conduct, in which we find the duties of a Vaiṣṇava in full.

আর যত গ্রন্থ কৈলা, তাহা কে করে গণন ৷
মদনগোপাল-গোবিন্দের ‘সেবা’-প্রকাশন ॥ ২২২ ॥

āra yata grantha kailā, tāhā ke kare gaṇana
other how many books he made that who makes counting
madana-gopāla-govindera ‘sevā’-prakāśana
of Madana-gopāla and Govinda the service the manifestation

222Who can count the other books he wrote? And he manifested the service of Madana-gopāla and Govinda.30

রূপ-গোসাঞি কৈলা ‘রসামৃতসিন্ধু’ সার ৷
কৃষ্ণভক্তি-রসের যাঁহা পাইয়ে বিস্তার ॥ ২২৩ ॥

rūpa-gosāñi kailā ‘rasāmṛta-sindhu’ sāra
Rūpa Gosāñi made the Rasāmṛta-sindhu the essence
kṛṣṇa-bhakti-rasera yām̐hā pāiye vistāra
of devotion to Kṛṣṇa of the rasa in which we find the full exposition

223Rūpa Gosāñi wrote the Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu, the essence of all, in which we find the full exposition of the rasa of devotion to Kṛṣṇa.

‘উজ্জ্বলনীলমণি’-নাম গ্রন্থ কৈল আর ৷
রাধাকৃষ্ণ-লীলারস তাঁহা পাইয়ে পার ॥ ২২৪ ॥

‘ujjvala-nīlamaṇi’-nāma grantha kaila āra
the Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi named a book he made also
rādhā-kṛṣṇa-līlā-rasa tām̐hā pāiye pāra
of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa the pastimes’ rasa there we find to the end

224He also wrote the book named Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi, where we find the rasa of the pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa to its utmost.

‘বিদগ্ধমাধব’, ‘ললিতমাধব’, — নাটকযুগল ৷
কৃষ্ণলীলা-রস তাঁহা পাইয়ে সকল ॥ ২২৫ ॥

‘vidagdha-mādhava’, ‘lalita-mādhava’, — nāṭaka-yugala
the Vidagdha-mādhava the Lalita-mādhava a pair of dramas
kṛṣṇa-līlā-rasa tām̐hā pāiye sakala
of Kṛṣṇa’s pastimes the rasa there we find all

225In the two dramas Vidagdha-mādhava and Lalita-mādhava we find all the rasa of Kṛṣṇa’s pastimes.

‘দানকেলিকৌমুদী’ আদি লক্ষগ্রন্থ কৈলা ৷
সেই সব গ্রন্থে ব্রজের রস বিচারিলা ॥ ২২৬ ॥

‘dāna-keli-kaumudī’ ādi lakṣa-grantha kailā
the Dāna-keli-kaumudī and others a hundred thousand granthas he made
sei saba granthe vrajera rasa vicārilā
in those all books of Vraja the rasa he examined

226He wrote the Dāna-keli-kaumudī and other works — a hundred thousand granthas in all — and in all those books he examined the rasa of Vraja.31

তাঁর লঘুভ্রাতা — শ্রীবল্লভ-অনুপম ৷
তাঁর পুত্র মহাপণ্ডিত — শ্রীজীব-নাম ॥ ২২৭ ॥

tām̐ra laghu-bhrātā — śrī-vallabha-anupama
his younger brother Śrī Vallabha Anupama
tām̐ra putra mahā-paṇḍita — śrī-jīva-nāma
his son a great scholar Śrī Jīva by name

227His younger brother was Śrī Vallabha, called Anupama, whose son was the great scholar named Śrī Jīva.

সর্ব্ব ত্যজি’ তেঁহো পাছে আইলা বৃন্দাবন ৷
তেঁহ ভক্তিশাস্ত্র বহু কৈলা প্রচারণ ॥ ২২৮ ॥

sarva tyaji’ tem̐ho pāche āilā vṛndāvana
everything having given up he later came to Vṛndāvana
tem̐ha bhaktiśāstra bahu kailā pracāraṇa
he scriptures on devotion many made propagation

228Giving up everything, he later came to Vṛndāvana and propagated many scriptures of bhakti.

‘ভাগবত-সন্দর্ভ’-নাম কৈলা গ্রন্থ-সার ৷
ভাগবত-সিদ্ধান্তের তাঁহা পাইয়ে পার ॥ ২২৯ ॥

‘bhāgavata-sandarbha’-nāma kailā grantha-sāra
the Bhāgavata-sandarbha named he made the essence of books
bhāgavata-siddhāntera tām̐hā pāiye pāra
of the Bhāgavata the conclusions there we find to the end

229He wrote the Bhāgavata-sandarbha, the essence of all books, where we find the conclusions of the Bhāgavatam in all their depth.32

‘গোপাল-চম্পূ’ আর নানা গ্রন্থ কৈলা ৷
ব্রজ প্রেম-লীলা-রস-সার দেখাইলা ॥ ২৩০ ॥

‘gopāla-campū’ āra nānā grantha kailā
the Gopāla-campū also many books he made
vraja prema-līlā-rasa-sāra dekhāilā
of Vraja the love-pastimes’ rasa the essence he showed

230He also wrote the Gopāla-campū and many other books, in which he revealed the essence of the rasa of Vraja’s love-pastimes.

‘ষট্সন্দর্ভে’ কৃষ্ণপ্রেম-তত্ত্ব প্রকাশিলা ৷
চারিলক্ষ গ্রন্থ তেঁহো বিস্তার করিলা ॥ ২৩১ ॥

‘ṣaṭ-sandarbhe’ kṛṣṇa-prema-tattva prakāśilā
in the Ṣaṭ-sandarbha of love for Kṛṣṇa the truth he revealed
cāri-lakṣa grantha tem̐ho vistāra karilā
four hundred thousand granthas he expansion made

231In the Ṣaṭ-sandarbha he revealed the truth of love for Kṛṣṇa. He composed four hundred thousand granthas in all.

জীব-গোসাঞি গৌড় হৈতে মথুরা চলিলা ৷
নিত্যানন্দপ্রভু ঠাঞি আজ্ঞা মাগিলা ॥ ২৩২ ॥

jīva-gosāñi gauḍa haite mathurā calilā
Jīva Gosāñi from Gauḍa to Mathurā set out
nityānanda-prabhu ṭhāñi ājñā māgilā
from Nityānanda Prabhu permission he begged

232When Jīva Gosāñi was setting out from Gauḍa for Mathurā, he begged leave of Nityānanda Prabhu.

প্রভু প্রীত্যে তাঁর মাথে ধরিলা চরণ ৷
রূপ-সনাতন-সম্বন্ধে কৈলা আলিঙ্গন ॥ ২৩৩ ॥

prabhu prītye tām̐ra māthe dharilā caraṇa
the Lord (Nityānanda) with love on his head placed His feet
rūpa-sanātana-sambandhe kailā āliṅgana
because of his relation to Rūpa and Sanātana He made embrace

233With love Nityānanda Prabhu placed His feet on Jīva’s head, and because he was related to Rūpa and Sanātana, He embraced him.

আজ্ঞা দিলা, — শীঘ্র তুমি যাহ’ বৃন্দাবনে ৷
তোমার বংশে প্রভু দিয়াছেন সেইস্থানে ॥ ২৩৪ ॥

ājñā dilā, — śīghra tumi yāha’ vṛndāvane
order He gave quickly you go to Vṛndāvana
tomāra vaṁśe prabhu diyāchena seisthāne
to your family the Lord has given that place

234He ordered him, “Go quickly to Vṛndāvana. The Lord has given that place to your family.”

তাঁর আজ্ঞায় আইলা, আজ্ঞা-ফল পাইলা ৷
শাস্ত্র করি’ কতকাল ‘ভক্তি’ প্রচারিলা ॥ ২৩৫ ॥

tām̐ra ājñāya āilā, ājñā-phala pāilā
by His order he came of the order the fruit he obtained
śāstra kari’ kata-kāla ‘bhakti’ pracārilā
scriptures having composed for a long time devotion he preached

235By His order he came, and he obtained the fruit of obeying it: composing scriptures, he preached bhakti for a long time.

এই তিনগুরু, আর রঘুনাথদাস ৷
ইঁহা-সবার চরণ বন্দোঁ, যাঁর মুঞি ‘দাস’ ॥ ২৩৬ ॥

ei tina-guru, āra raghunāthadāsa
these three gurus and Raghunātha dāsa
im̐hā-sabāra caraṇa vandom̐, yām̐ra muñi ‘dāsa’
of all these the feet I worship whose I servant

236These three gurus and Raghunātha dāsa — I worship the feet of them all, for I am their servant.33

এই ত’ কহিলুঁ পুনঃ সনাতন-সঙ্গমে ৷
প্রভুর আশয় জানি যাহার শ্রবণে ॥ ২৩৭ ॥

ei ta’ kahilum̐ punaḥ sanātana-saṅgame
this indeed I have told again the meeting with Sanātana
prabhura āśaya jāni yāhāra śravaṇe
of the Lord the intention we know which by hearing

237Thus I have told of the meeting with Sanātana once again; by hearing of it we come to know the Lord’s intention.

চৈতন্যচরিত্র এই — ইক্ষুদণ্ড-সম ৷
চর্ব্বণ করিতে হয় রস-আস্বাদন ॥ ২৩৮ ॥

caitanya-caritra ei — ikṣu-daṇḍa-sama
of Caitanya the deeds these like sugarcane
carvaṇa karite haya rasa-āsvādana
chewing when one does comes of the juice the taste

238These deeds of Caitanya are like sugarcane: chew it, and you taste its juice.

শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ৷
চৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥ ২৩৯ ॥

śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
Śrī Rūpa’s, Raghunātha’s at the feet whose hope
caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
“Caitanya-caritāmṛta” narrates Kṛṣṇadāsa

239Praying at the feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate the Caitanya-caritāmṛta.34

Notes

  1. Edition heading: “Gaurasundara saves Sanātana from his resolve to give up the body.” Śuddhaṁ cakre parīkṣayā — “by a test He made him pure”; the healing of his body (201) is its visible sign.
  2. The same verse as Ādi 4.2 (= Ādi 1.18, 17.2, Antya 2.2); translation as there.
  3. Anubhāṣya: nirveda — detachment (virakti), not worldly despair; asāra — unfit for the service of Kṛṣṇa.
  4. Gaṅgā-prāpti, “attaining the Gaṅgā”: departing from the world on the bank of the Gaṅgā (Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya, summary of the chapter).
  5. Deha-tyāga — “giving up the body”. Edition heading to 55: addressing Sanātana, the Lord teaches the sādhaka who is not yet free of anarthas and is led by his own mind: false (phalgu) knowledge and false renunciation are no means of attaining Kṛṣṇa.
  6. The same verse as Ādi 17.76 (= Madhya 20.137); translation as there. The Anubhāṣya refers to Ādi 17.76.
  7. Edition heading: “Rukmiṇī reveals her anurāga to Vāsudeva.” Anubhāṣya: vrata-kṛśān — emaciated by vows, by fasts and the like.
  8. Anubhāṣya: hṛc-chaya — the desire of love born in the heart of the gopīs and dwelling there; kala-gīta — the sweet song, the sweet sound of the flute.
  9. Edition heading to 66: refutation of the doctrine of nobility by seed, born of union with a woman; who is fit for the service of Kṛṣṇa; only the pure devotee is the guru, the greatest of men.
  10. The same verse as Madhya 20.59; translation as there. The Anubhāṣya refers to Madhya 20.59.
  11. Anubhāṣya: nirāparādhe — free of the ten offences against the name, serving the name constantly and untiringly.
  12. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: you have given Me your body, and you have no right to give it up.
  13. Anubhāṣya (on 79–81): through Sanātana the Lord established the service of the Deity in maṭhas and temples and the inner service in the mood of Vraja, and by his recovering the lost holy places and by his life He taught the renunciation befitting a devotee (yukta-vairāgya).
  14. Anubhāṣya: sthāpya — what is given in trust; anyāya — the destruction of his body, given to Kṛṣṇa.
  15. Edition heading: “Success, or perfection, is the servant who follows Kṛṣṇa’s will”; sei siddha haya — “he (the servant) attains perfection.”
  16. Anubhāṣya: sevaka-prabhu — the servant and the Master, Śrī Sanātana and Śrīman Mahāprabhu.
  17. Piṇḍā — a raised earthen platform beside a dwelling. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: nirviṇṇa — filled with nirveda, that is, detachment (virāga).
  18. Nīca-jāti — “of low birth” (cf. 6, 28, 66–67).
  19. Anubhāṣya: vyavahāra-bhakti — the showing of propriety (maryādā), the conduct of the cultured (śiṣṭācāra); for such occasions see Madhya 1.222–224 or 16.266.
  20. Anubhāṣya: whatever is spoken in words, seen by the senses or conceived by the mind is transitory, not true for all time; whatever is other than the non-dual Truth has no separate being. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: duality is a perception not of Kṛṣṇa, the non-dual Truth, but of something else, born of māyā; in the perception of the non-dual Truth there is no ‘good’ and ‘bad’.
  21. Anubhāṣya: paṇḍitāḥ — those who know what bondage is and what liberation; sama-darśinaḥ — those whose nature is to see one and the same Brahman in all.
  22. Anubhāṣya: jñāna — knowledge received through instruction, vijñāna — direct realisation; yuktaḥ — established in yoga (yoga-ārūḍha).
  23. Anubhāṣya: out of affection the one who cherishes does not notice the faults of the one he cherishes, even if they are there.
  24. The same verse as Madhya 22.100; translation as there. The reference follows the edition heading; the Anubhāṣya refers to Madhya 22.101 in the edition’s numbering (22.100 in ours).
  25. Anubhāṣya: catuḥsama is a perfume of two parts musk, four of sandal, three of kuṅkuma (saffron) and one of camphor (Garuḍa Purāṇa; see Hari-bhakti-vilāsa, 6.115). Anubhāṣya: only to a sense of smell led by a mind turned towards worldly enjoyment could the body of Sanātana, an associate wholly given to Kṛṣṇa’s service, seem foul.
  26. Anubhāṣya: pānī-lakṣye — making the drinking water of Jhārikhaṇḍa the pretext. Edition heading to 202: Sanātana’s body, wholly guided by the Lord’s will, only displayed to the eye of the senses the suffering of oozing sores.
  27. Edition heading: having met the devotees on the way, Sanātana continues his journey.
  28. Anubhāṣya: the proofs from these scriptures are given in the Bhakti-ratnākara.
  29. Anubhāṣya: the Daśama-ṭippanī is the commentary Bṛhad-vaiṣṇava-toṣaṇī.
  30. Anubhāṣya (on 218): in Vṛndāvana Śrī Sanātana manifested the service of Śrī Madana-mohana, and Śrī Rūpa that of Śrī Govinda.
  31. Anubhāṣya: Śrī Rūpa’s books contain about a hundred thousand ślokas, for copyists count both verse and prose in granthas; it does not mean a hundred thousand books: by the Bhakti-ratnākara, Śrī Rūpa wrote sixteen books.
  32. Anubhāṣya: its other name is the Ṣaṭ-sandarbha (see Madhya 1.43).
  33. Anubhāṣya: the author’s three instructing gurus are Śrī Rūpa, Sanātana and Śrī Jīva Gosvāmī.
  34. The same colophon verse as Antya 2.172; translation as there.
